entry.title: Fault-Tolerant Logical Magic-State Distillation on Bivariate Bicycle Quantum LDPC Codes
entry.summary:
Surface codes require over $1{,}000$ physical qubits per logical qubit at realistic gate error rates $p \approx 10^{-3}$. We demonstrate a constant-depth magic-state factory directly on high-rate bivariate bicycle qLDPC codes ($[[144, 12, 12]]$), achieving logical $T$-gate infidelity below $10^{-9}$ with $6.8\times$ fewer physical qubits than planar lattice surgery.

Source: arXiv Quantum Physics (quant-ph) · Tags: #quantum-computing #quantum-physics
